description: Sent Tuesday, September 8, 2026.Issue 2 covered the Operating Engineers Local 49 endorsement, the three dates that decide this seat (absentee ballots September 18, early in-person voting October 16, Election Day November 3), the 375th Fox sign going into a yard, and a door knock schedule that now runs four days a week: Wednesday at 5, Thursday at 5, Saturday at 11 and Sunday at 2.Read Issue 2 as it was emailedNew issues go out most weeks.
